text: Alla piyii misal hoɗo Makka ngon: Nde wonno hoolinoonde nde hulaa yimɓe mun, deeƴirnde e yimɓe seraaji mayre ɓen, arsike mayre on no ardirana nde nokku kala e neweende. Kono yimɓe mayre nden njeddi neemaaji Alla ɗin e dow maɓɓe ɓe ronki yettude Mo, Alla yoɓitiri ɓe heege e kulol tiiɗungol, feeñringol e ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin ɗenƴere e maƴaango, haa ɗum wontira ɓe wa conci maɓɓe, sabu ko ɓe laatinoo hiɓe huuwa golle keeferaaku e fennugol.
